name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Edison goes with at least one of Robotics, Structural, or $62k.
Chemical does not go with Otis if and only if at least one of Aerospace goes with Bell, Structural goes with Tesla, or Hertz goes with Electrical.
Aerospace, Chemical, and Electrical go with Edison, Otis, and Tesla, in some order.
Either $52k goes with Electrical or Hertz goes with $52k.
Between $62k and $72k, one goes with Edison and the other with Electrical.
Either Structural goes with Hertz or $42k goes with Edison.
Bell's budget is between Otis and the Electrical engineer.
